newsitem.title: USA: Chancellor to change Kmart announcement.
newsitem.headline: Chancellor to change Kmart announcement.

text.p: Chancellor Corp President Marilyn Bess said the company on Thursday will issue a new announcement regarding its statement Tuesday that it signed a $150 million real estate deal with Kmart Corp.
"We are going to make changes to the announcement," Bess said in a telephone interview from Chancellor's offices in Sausalito, Calif. She declined to elaborate on the changes.

On Tuesday, Chancellor said it signed a contract to purchase 15 of Kmart's Builders Square stores for $150 million in a sale-leaseback transaction. It added that Kmart will sign 25-year leases at each of the stores.
Kmart on Tuesday denied signing a contract with Chancellor and asked the Sausalito, Calif.-based real estate acquisition firm to retract its release.
Chancellor shares fell 1-1/2 to 3-1/2 on Wednesday.
